doc: Where quest 1's stage (collect_call_stage.json + collect_call_places.json, stage metres) sits on the generated city: world = origin + stage * squash. The stage is laid along one east-west street so every leg Rivet walks stays on it; origin found by res://dev/quest1_city_fit.gd (re-fit 2026-11-03 for the 12 m streets, was 276, 265.85; the 12 m kerb strip moved the clear y) (every place and walked leg clear of buildings, props and parked cars). ghost_cars: parked cars (world metres, nose east) on the street for the ghost powers (Dent seizes them; quest 1 had no car); fit with res://dev/ghost-powers/ghost_cars_fit.gd (clear of buildings, props, kerbs and the baked parked cars). ghost_cars is [] since d7-calls ghost-powers-5 (owner 2026-11-05: Dent is locked in quest 1, so the street needs no ghost cars); the fitted three were [[279, 260.5], [364, 260], [386, 266]] (put them back = the old default).

dock_place.doc: n18 districts item 5, read only under --quest1-places (StageDockPlace): Dock 9's own stage points (markers, spawn_points, props: crates + the metal around vault-cage) leave the street and sit around the city's dock_9 place (data/tables/places.json): stage_anchor (the bonded storage marker's middle) stands out_m in front of the place's door along its facing, stage north towards the building, the street's squash kept. Off (the default): the whole stage on the fitted street.
